intent: Lay out the controls the page is worked with at the end of the header.
typical_uses: The page's primary button, such as "New project"
A row of buttons with a menu of further actions

dont_use_when.situation: Navigation between the sections of the page

invariants.text: PageHeaderActions is a flex row that centers its children vertically, spaces them var(--space-2) apart, does not shrink, and wraps its children onto further lines, var(--space-2) apart, when they do not fit; the root's gap plus its own var(--space-2) margin puts var(--space-6) between it and the text block.
When the header's width inside its side insets is below 64rem it takes a line of its own, flush with the start of the header.

anti_patterns.dont: Add a margin to space the actions from the title
anti_patterns.do_instead: Leave it - the root's gap and the part's own margin already make the drawn var(--space-6), and a margin of yours would add to it

anti_patterns.dont: Put the page's section navigation at the end of the header
anti_patterns.do_instead: Put it beside the title, in PageHeaderMeta

good.title: Two buttons and a menu of further actions
good.code:
<PageHeaderActions>
  <Button variant="outline">Edit dashboard</Button>
  <Button>New project</Button>
  <Button variant="ghost" icon={<EllipsisIcon />} aria-label="More actions" />
</PageHeaderActions>

bad.title: Section links set among the actions
bad.why: Navigation between the page's sections belongs beside the title it divides, in PageHeaderMeta; among the actions it reads as one more command and loses its tie to the title.
